context: Written on 2026-11-16 for the second rework batch. The skill was then revised against this task, so its with-skill score here is partly by construction. Measured without the skill on 2026-11-16 (Sonnet agent and Sonnet judge, 2 runs, pass/fail per criterion): predicted baseline failure is that the agent misses 'Presign checks ownership' (1 of 2 runs), 'Cache key includes the tenant' (1 of 2 runs). Converted from a four-criterion pass/fail screen; per EVALS.md, run a sham arm before quoting a lift from it.

checklist.name: Deliverables produced
checklist.description: ANSWER.md exists and holds the findings plus the final content of every file the agent created or changed. Scores zero if ANSWER.md is missing or no file the task needs was created or changed.

checklist.name: MUST NOT answer another tenant's resources with 403
checklist.description: From the skill's anti-pattern '403 used instead of 404 for unauthorised cross-tenant resources'. Any route that answers a foreign id differently from a missing one (403, a different message, or a different body) scores zero. Full points when the work avoids it.

checklist.name: Invite reveals other tenants' users
checklist.description: The answer flags that the global email check (and global UNIQUE) tells tenant B that an address exists in tenant A, and fixes it (uniqueness scoped per tenant, or a response that does not reveal it), with a test. Full points only if the answer and the changed files do all of this. Half if it names the problem but the fix or the explanation is incomplete. Scores zero if it is missing or wrong.

checklist.name: Presign checks ownership
checklist.description: The presign endpoint only signs keys under the caller's own `docs/<tenant_id>/` prefix, rejecting other prefixes and path tricks such as `..`, with a test that tenant B cannot presign tenant A's key. Full points only if the answer and the changed files do all of this. Half if it names the problem but the fix or the explanation is incomplete. Scores zero if it is missing or wrong.

checklist.name: Cache key includes the tenant
checklist.description: The cache key includes the tenant id; the answer shows that tenant A's cached invoice is otherwise served to tenant B (the 403 check then leaks existence), with a test where A warms the cache and B gets 404. Full points only if the answer and the changed files do all of this. Half if it names the problem but the fix or the explanation is incomplete. Scores zero if it is missing or wrong.

checklist.name: Same response for missing and foreign
checklist.description: Another tenant's invoice id returns the same 404 as a missing id, not 403. Full points only if the answer and the changed files do all of this. Half if it names the problem but the fix or the explanation is incomplete. Scores zero if it is missing or wrong.
